installed_asset_inventory.startup_effect: Most inventory candidates are not fetched on the first screen; deleting them reduces release size and update cost but not first-composer time unless their imports are also removed.

families: onboarding, team, sharing, artifact and debug helpers

main_bundle_coverage.interpretation: This is an upper-bound first-screen coverage estimate. It excludes zero-count function bodies but does not exclude unexecuted branches inside called functions.

tree_shaking_probe.conclusion: The compiled upstream chunk has a large shared side-effect floor. Useful reduction requires changing the pkc/ekc source or route boundaries; deleting strings or importing fewer names from the existing chunk cannot produce a genuinely small math-proof shell.

math_proof_keep: App Server IPC and authenticated session bootstrap
account route entry and native identity synchronization
thread list, conversation state and streaming transcript
bounded syntax highlighting for common proof and code formats
file upload, persistent attachments and output download
skill invocation and goal progress surfaces
math_proof_remove_or_defer: Computer Use, browser use and record/replay
pets, mascots, games and their sprite sheets
AppGen, canvas, notebook and appshot demonstrations
pull-request, team sharing and referral surfaces
unused locales, editor themes and uncommon language grammars
debug panels and nonessential telemetry clients

recommended_sequence.change: Move the 27 clearly optional script families behind post-composer or explicit-navigation imports.
Create a hash-pinned math-proof startup root that replaces the pkc initializer aggregate and ekc App root with only chat, IPC, account entry, attachments and proof rendering.
recommended_sequence.risk: high; requires route and feature-contract tests because upstream source maps are absent

recommended_sequence.change: Replace disabled Statsig/Sentry clients with build-time no-op adapters instead of only short-circuiting their network requests.
Produce a math-proof release allowlist for locales, themes, grammars and static feature assets after route pruning is complete.
recommended_sequence.risk: low for disk size, no direct cold-start gain without import pruning

recommended_sequence.change: Add HTTPS so the browser can select the existing Brotli main bundle rather than the current gzip response.
recommended_sequence.risk: medium; this is a transport optimization rather than package trimming

residual_risks: The browser result is one fresh-profile observation, not a stable performance guarantee.
The upstream proprietary main chunk has no source map, so feature attribution combines network names, V8 coverage and isolated-export tree-shaking probes.
Static candidate groups overlap and must not be summed as independent savings.
PDF preview, Markdown, LaTeX, KaTeX, attachments, commands and skill progress must remain available for math-proof work.
No deployed file or service was changed by this audit.
